scenarios.title: New Browser Tab hosts a sandboxed system WebKit view in the current worktree without starting Chrome; switching tabs/worktrees destroys the native view and returning restores one view at the retained URL; resize/overlays keep native bounds aligned
Native browser address, Back/Forward/Reload/Stop, same-document navigation and Find previous/next/count/close change the actual embedded page and reflect real state
Native browser zoom applies real WebKit page zoom for half-step levels and reset; viewport menu and native geometry stay coherent when resized and shown again
Opening an owned local HTML fixture displays its native page; Open source file opens that exact canonical in-worktree file in the editor and unsafe outside-worktree source actions fail visibly

While typing in a real terminal pane, agent browser input and Watch updates never steal macOS window or typing focus; browser-specific shortcuts do not override terminal/editor bindings outside browser focus
